parameters.name: ImageData
parameters.description:
The Base64-encoded string of the image. For information about Base64 encoding of files, refer to [File Base64 processing](~~468191~~).

> Specify either **ImageURL** or **ImageData**. If both are specified, the URL takes precedence.

parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description:
The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an OSS link in the Shanghai region. For files stored locally or in OSS links outside the Shanghai region, refer to [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

> Specify either **ImageURL** or **ImageData**. If both are specified, the URL takes precedence. For information about Base64 encoding of files, refer to [File Base64 processing](~~468191~~).
